comparison.objective: Transfer a size-ordered tower without placing a larger piece on a smaller one versus tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential pick-and-place planning under ordering constraints versus fine tool alignment, collar rotation, bounded locking, and physical cycle testing.
comparison.success_condition: Tower transfer must obey the no-big-on-small rule; candidate must pass explicit energy, velocity, stroke, response, and retention checks.
comparison.reason: The tower task tests manipulation planning and stacking, not mechanical commissioning. Destination and completion details beyond the title are absent.
